info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to sin, to soil, to make impure, to cause pain, to hurt

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: duHKita honA yA karanA, dUzita karanA

examples: 'avfttikarSitA hi strI praduzyet sTitimatyapi' (manu॰9.74). vikAramApnuyAt, patiM vyaBicarediti tAtparyArTaH.

'yadi yAsyati sanduzwA rAmasyAklizwakarmaRaH. neyaM svastimatI senA gaNgAmadya tarizyati' (rA॰gore॰saM॰2.91.11). sanduzwA=vikftamanAH=anizwasaNkalpA. samA nArTaH, yaTA praduzwavipraduzwayorviprAByAM nArTaH.
'priyA tazwAni me kapirvyaktA vyadUduzat' (f0 10.86.5). vyadUduzat=vyakarot, vEkftamanEzIt.
'kaTaM vayaM nivatsyAmaH kEkeyyA ca vidUzitAH' (rA0 2.66.21). vidUzitA rAjyagarvAt tiraskftA iti tilakakAraH.
'na Sezo anyajAtamastyacetAnasya mA paTo vi dukzaH' (f0 7.4.7). mA vidukzaH=mA vidUduzaH.
'vedAstyAgaSca yajYASca niyamASca tapAMsi ca. na vipraduzwaBAvasya sidDiM gacCanti karhicit' (manu0 2.97).. vipraduzwaBAvasya duzwasvaBAvasya. viprAvanarTakO.
'na BinnaBARqe BuYjIta na BAvapratidUzite' (manu0 4.65). BAvapratidUzitaM=yatra mano vicikitsati, nirRiktatAmasya BARqasya SaNkate.

'anena pratiduzwakarmaRA hatA BavedAryapaTe pare sTitA' (rA0 5.12.3). atra pAWaSudDiratiSaNkyate. neha pratirupasargaH. loke vyavahitasyopasargasya prayogABAvAt. nipAtasya satopyarTo'sPuwaH. etezu cArTezu pratiSabdaM paWatyamaraH--pratiH pratiniDO vIpsAlakzaRAdO prayogataH.
'parAmfzwA apyasaMraktA nopaduzyanti yozitaH' (hari0 3.5.39). nopaduzyanti na patanti na patitA Bavanti.
